content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?NASA Artemis's PostNASA Artemis Verified accountMarch 30 at 10:29 PM · Shared with PublicCountdown has started for launch.The launch control team recently arrived at their stations and the official countdown for the launch of the Artemis II mission began at 4:44 p.m. EDT (2044 UTC). Teams will begin methodically going through the launch countdown checklist to prepare for the liftoff of the crewed lunar mission — currently scheduled for no earlier than 6:24 p.m. EDT (2224 UTC) on Wednesday, April 1. The forecast shows an 80% chance of favorable weather conditions. https://go.nasa.gov/4sL4j3xAll reactions:110K6.3K comments16K sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Annie FarmerMy dad developed the solid rocket booster that put man on the moon the first time.
